descripcion_geo: Mediterranean coastal strip southwest of Canaan; territory of the five Philistine cities: Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron.
importancia_estrategica: Control of the coastal plain and trade routes between Egypt and northern Canaan.

historias.descripcion: Samson, Nazirite of the Lord, kills a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey and dies demolishing the temple of Dagon in Gaza.

historias.titulo: The ark captured by the Philistines
historias.descripcion: The Philistines capture the Ark of the Covenant in Ebenezer; pests force them to return it to Israel.
The young David kills the Philistine giant Goliath with a sling and stone; Israel defeats the Philistine army.

personajes.descripcion: Giant Warrior by Gath; killed by David with a slingshot.
He discovered the secret of Samson's strength and gave it to the Philistines.
He gave shelter to David when he was fleeing from Saul.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Warrior people with worship of Dagon and Baal-Zebub; quintessential enemies of Israel in the era of judges and monarchy.

judaismo.descripcion: When the ark arrived at the temple of Dagon in Ashdod, the statue of the god was found torn down before the ark (1 Sam 5:1-4).
judaismo.significado_teologico: When the ark arrived at the temple of Dagon in Ashdod, the statue of the god was found torn down before the ark (1 Sam 5:1-4).
